programs.title: UFO: POV
programs.desc: Renowned UFO expert Chris Rutkowski investigates real unexplained encounters, combining eyewitness testimony, on-the-ground investigation, and decades of research to uncover what really happened.

programs.title: Deadly Science
programs.sub_title: In the Name of Medicine (Jesse Lazear, Alexander Bogdonov, Michael Servetus)
programs.desc: Although modern medicine is capable of incredible feats, the ability to treat the human body follows hundreds of years of experimentation -- at times with deadly results.

programs.title: Secrets in the Ice
programs.desc: Human remains high in the Ecuadorian Andes; in Norway, an archaeology student unearths metal artifacts; a strange, earthquake-like event in Canada; a Viking longhouse with a unique history in Greenland.

programs.title: How I Got Here
programs.desc: Shaun travels back to Zimbabwe to face the land he loves and the political climate that forced him to leave; his daughter Shannon begins to embrace her personal identity as a biracial woman.

programs.title: Ancient Bodies: Secrets Revealed
programs.desc: The human remains of a woman are found near Vejle, Denmark; an archaeologist begins to tell a story about who she was and why she was murdered, connecting her to ancient fairy tales and even King Harald Bluetooth.

programs.title: A Cold War of Spies
programs.sub_title: The Battle Over Hearts and Minds
programs.desc: At the close of WWII, the West views Stalin's government as a threat to democracy, while Stalin sees America as an obstacle in winning the 'hearts and minds' of oppressed people everywhere; Communist leaders try to shut down so-called freedom radios.
